senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) rows of plants in one bed, also (= זְרָעִים) seeds.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:2">Kil. II, 2</cite> <he>זֵרְעוֹנֵי גנה וכ׳</he> garden seeds which are not used for food, i.e. seeds of vegetables; <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 3:14">Tosef. Maasr. III, 14</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 9:7">Sabb. IX, 7</cite>. Tosef. l. c. <he>ז׳ שדה</he> field seeds (e.g. vetch &c.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 3:1">Kil. III, 1</cite> <he>חמשה ז׳</he> five rows of different seeds; a. fr.
